production.note: US model years. duPont Registry News (Gabriel Vega, 24 May 2023) introduces the car as the '2024 Aston Martin DB12'. Aston (am-db12-release-2023, 24 May 2023): 'Deliveries scheduled to begin Q3 2023'. Still on sale; endYear null.

body.note: 2+2 coupe. The DB12 Volante is sold under its own name and is not part of this record.

displacementL.note: Aston brochure: '4.0 litres'. No opened page gives the cc figure.

drivetrain.note: Rear-wheel drive with an Electronic Rear Differential.

powerHp.note: Quote (Aston Martin, 24 May 2023): "class-leading 680PS/671bhp at 6000rpm and 800Nm/590lb ft between 2750-6000rpm". 680 PS x 0.98632 = 670.7 hp, rounded to 671. duPont Registry gives the US car '671 Horsepower' (dupont-db12-2024).

weightLb.note: Dry weight (weight-order step 4): no manufacturer or magazine-panel curb weight and no curb weight from two named-author outlets was found. Quote (Evo, Stuart Gallagher, 30 May 2023): "Aston Martin quotes a 1685kg dry weight for the DB12". 1,685 kg x 2.20462 = 3,714.8 lb, rounded to 3,715. Top Gear (topgear-db12-reveal, Ollie Marriage): "this comes in at 1,685kg. That's a dry weight"; its 'reckon on around 1,820kg' is the writer's own estimate and is not used. duPont Registry: '3,714-pound dry weight' (dupont-db12-2024). No opened page says whether the dry figure is for an optioned car.
